CustomField.description: The Use building-number sequence setting ensures that units within one building on a blockface will be serviced before units in other buildings on that blockface when the buildings share the same location (X, Y coordinates). If this option is chosen and you have populated the [Building] field with either a building number or a preferred sequence, stops with the same coordinates will be grouped by their building value and the buildings will be sequenced in the specified order.
CustomField.label: Use Building
